descriptionFromApi:
Job Summary
The Technical Scrum Master will lead agile delivery for the AWS Policy Master engineering pod and serve as the execution bridge among product owners, business and policy SMEs, solution architecture, data engineering, API, database, DevSecOps, and quality teams. The role combines strong Scrum facilitation with sufficient AWS and data-engineering fluency to manage technical dependencies, remove impediments, maintain delivery transparency, and drive predictable releases across the S3LambdaSQSAuroraAPI flow. The individual will not act as the solution architect, but must be comfortable challenging plans, surfacing delivery risk, and translating technical progress into business-ready status.
Location: Bangalore, Karnataka, India.
Required Skills and Experience
  • 810 years of overall technology delivery experience, including at least 4 years as a Scrum Master or agile delivery lead for data, cloud, integration, or application-modernization teams.
  • Strong working knowledge of Scrum and Kanban practices, sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, release planning, velocity, capacity, and dependency management.
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering teams spanning cloud data pipelines, APIs or microservices, database engineering, DevSecOps, automation testing, and production support.
  • Practical understanding of AWS delivery concepts - S3, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, Aurora PostgreSQL, API Gateway, IAM, CloudWatch, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code - to facilitate informed technical planning and risk discussions.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cross-team dependencies, RAID items, critical paths, nonfunctional requirements, environment readiness, testing gates, and release or cutover activities.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence or equivalent agile lifecycle tools; ability to create actionable dashboards and concise executive status reports.
  • Strong facilitation, conflict-resolution, stakeholder-management, written communication, and coaching skills; comfortable working across onsite and offshore teams and multiple time zones.
  • Experience in insurance, policy administration, operational data stores, data mastering, or regulated financial-services programs is strongly preferred.
  • Scrum certification such as CSM, PSM, SAFe Scrum Master, or PMI-ACP is preferred; AWS Cloud Practitioner or similar foundational cloud certification is an advantage.
Duties
  • Facilitate sprint ceremonies and ensure each sprint has clear objectives, prioritized stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, estimates, and accountable owners.
  • Partner with the Product Owner and technical leads to maintain a healthy backlog covering ingestion, validation, buffering, transformation, canonical policy data, Aurora persistence, APIs, observability, security, and reliability.
  • Build and maintain integrated sprint and release plans across AWS data engineering, Aurora data modeling, API engineering, DevSecOps, testing, business SMEs, and dependent source or consumer teams.
  • Identify, track, and remove delivery impediments; escalate architecture, access, environment, data, security, vendor, or dependency blockers with clear impact and resolution dates.
  • Monitor sprint predictability, throughput, carryover, defect trends, test progress, technical debt, and release readiness; convert metrics into practical corrective actions rather than administrative reporting.
  • Coordinate technical design reviews, story readiness, definition-of-done adherence, nonfunctional requirement coverage, test evidence, production-readiness reviews, and go/no-go checkpoints.
  • Facilitate decision-making and conflict resolution while preserving clear accountability among the Product Owner, architects, engineering leads, and business stakeholders.
  • Drive continuous improvement through retrospectives, root-cause follow-up, dependency reduction, automation opportunities, and consistent agile engineering practices.
  • Provide concise weekly status covering accomplishments, upcoming milestones, risks, decisions, dependencies, staffing, and any impact to scope, schedule, quality, or cost.
  • Support cutover, hypercare, incident triage, and post-release reviews to ensure operational learning is incorporated into subsequent sprints.

jobDescription:
Job Summary
We are currently seeking a Systems Administration Senior Specialist to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India.
We are seeking a skilled Application Packager to join NTT DATA's India EPM delivery team. This mid-senior role involves independently managing complex packaging projects - handling difficult repackages, compatibility remediation, scripted deployments, and advanced Intune/SCCM integration - for large global enterprise clients. The packager will serve as a key technical contributor on the India packaging team, handling L2/L3 packaging requests, driving quality standards, and contributing to platform and tooling improvements.
Key Responsibilities
  • Advanced Application Packaging
  • Handle complex application repackaging scenarios including multi-component installers, 32/64-bit dual packages, per-user vs per-machine conflicts, and custom action remediation.
  • Develop and maintain MSI packages from source using WiX Toolset or InstallShield IDE for applications without vendor installers.
  • Apply Package Support Framework (PSF) fixups for MSIX compatibility including working directory, file redirection, and registry virtualisation fixes.
  • Package and sequence App-V virtual applications including connection group configuration and dynamic composition.
  • Design and implement Intune Win32 deployment strategies including staged rollouts, dependency chains, and supersedence workflows.
  • Develop custom PowerShell pre-install, post-install, and detection scripts for complex packaging requirements.
  • Compatibility Remediation
  • Analyse and resolve application compatibility issues including DPI awareness, UAC elevation, write virtualisation, and Windows 10/11 API compatibility.
  • Apply and test compatibility shims using Microsoft Application Compatibility Toolkit (ACT) or PSF.
  • Identify and remediate packaging issues causing deployment failures - custom actions, hardcoded paths, registry ACLs, and service configurations.
  • Collaborate with application owners and vendors to obtain silent install parameters and resolve licensing or activation issues.
  • Assess applications for MSIX packaging suitability and document conversion feasibility with recommended approach.
  • Deployment Integration Automation
  • Build SCCM application models with complex detection methods, global conditions, requirement rules, and multi-deployment-type configurations.
  • Develop PowerShell automation scripts for batch packaging operations, package validation, and SCCM/Intune inventory reporting.
  • Integrate packaging workflows with software delivery pipelines - scripted uploads to Intune via Graph API, SCCM package import automation.
  • Support Azure DevOps or CI/CD pipeline integration for automated package build and test workflows.
  • Develop and maintain packaging test scripts for regression automation on golden image environments.
  • Quality Governance
  • Define and enforce packaging standards, quality checklists, and peer review processes for the India packaging team.
  • Conduct technical review of packages produced by junior packagers and provide structured feedback.
  • Maintain and improve the packaging knowledge base, SOPs, and runbooks.
  • Contribute to SLA governance by tracking packaging queue metrics, turnaround times, and defect rates.
  • Participate in client delivery reviews and contribute packaging status updates and quality metrics.
Required Skills
  • Advanced MSI packaging - WiX Toolset; InstallShield; AdminStudio (expert-level repackaging and custom authoring)
  • MSIX packaging - Package Support Framework; MSIX Packaging Tool; advanced compatibility fix development
  • App-V sequencing - virtual application packaging; connection groups; dynamic configuration
  • Intune Win32 and SCCM deployment - advanced deployment type configuration; Graph API integration
  • PowerShell advanced scripting - detection scripts; pre/post-install automation; batch packaging operations
  • Application compatibility - ACT; shims; PSF fixups; UAC/DPI/virtualisation remediation
  • Windows internals - deep understanding of registry, file system, services, COM, WMI for packaging analysis
  • Log analysis and troubleshooting - MSI verbose logs; AppEnforce.log; CMTrace; Event Viewer; Procmon
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with AdminStudio's Automated Application Converter for bulk MSI-to-MSIX migration
  • Azure DevOps or CI/CD pipeline experience for packaging automation
  • Flexera Software Vulnerability Manager or third-party patch management integration
  • Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) or equivalent
Minimum Education
  • Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/BCA/B.Sc. IT/CS) or MCA from a recognised Indian university. Equivalent senior enterprise packaging experience will be considered.

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Lead Engineer with 5 to 10 years of expertise in advanced AI technologies, automation frameworks, and cloud-native solutions. Title: Expert Data Engineer
Shift: 11:00AM - 8:00PM
Work Mode: Hybrid
Location: Bangalore
Responsibilities
  • Own AI-ready data engineering. The AI Data Engineering Lead is accountable for engineering data assets that AI products can safely and effectively use.
  • Build and manage data pipelines that support AI-enabled applications, RAG solutions, agents, analytics, automation, and decision-support capabilities.
  • Ensure data used by AI products is complete, accurate, timely, traceable, and fit for purpose.
  • Create reusable data products that can serve multiple products, business units, and AI use cases.
  • Partner with product owners and AI engineers to define what data is required for prompts, retrieval, grounding, classification, extraction, recommendations, and workflow automation.
  • Ensure AI data assets are engineered for scale, resilience, security, cost efficiency, and production support.
  • Define data products for key domains such as client, entity, product, service, transaction, finance, risk, vendor, employee, jurisdiction, and reference data.
  • Establish clear data product ownership, service levels, quality expectations, refresh frequency, and access rules.
  • Create data pipelines that support both transactional product needs and AI/analytics needs.
  • Define source-of-truth usage and reduce reliance on uncontrolled spreadsheets, local files, and duplicate extracts.
  • Ensure data products are documented, discoverable, versioned, and reusable.
  • Partner with data stewards to resolve quality, definition, and ownership issues.
  • Prepare policies, procedures, contracts, regulatory content, service playbooks, product documentation, client obligations, and operational knowledge for AI retrieval.
  • Define document ingestion, parsing, chunking, embedding, indexing, refresh, and retirement processes.
  • Partner with AI engineering to design vector stores, semantic search, retrieval ranking, grounding, and citation patterns.
  • Ensure retrieval sources are approved, current, versioned, owned, and access-controlled.
  • Validate that AI products retrieve the right content for the right user in the right context.
  • Prevent AI products from using obsolete, conflicting, unauthorized, or unapproved knowledge sources.
  • Define data quality rules for critical data elements used by AI products.
  • Monitor completeness, accuracy, uniqueness, validity, consistency, and timeliness.
  • Build automated quality checks into pipelines.
  • Create exception handling, issue management, and remediation workflows.
  • Partner with data owners and product teams to prioritize data quality fixes based on business and AI impact.

  • Define business and technical metadata needed for AI use.
  • Document lineage from source systems through pipelines, transformations, vector stores, prompts, outputs, and consuming products.
  • Support auditability by making source-to-output traceability visible where required.
  • Partner with data governance teams to ensure definitions, ownership, sensitivity, and usage rules are documented.
  • Implement role-based, attribute-based, jurisdictional, client-specific, and purpose-based access controls.
  • Ensure AI products only use data that users, applications, models, and agents are authorized to access.
  • Partner with security and privacy teams to classify data sensitivity.
  • Prevent sensitive data from being exposed through prompts, logs, embeddings, outputs, or retrieved content.
  • Ensure data minimization, retention, masking, encryption, and audit logging requirements are met.
  • Design data access patterns that work across applications, APIs, data products, vector stores, and AI agents.
  • Support security and privacy reviews for AI-enabled products.
  • Monitor pipeline reliability, latency, and freshness.

What you will own


Expert network and influencer relationships


Identify, approach and build durable relationships with respected practitioners across the vertical: open-source maintainers, conference speakers, community leaders, technical bloggers and newsletter authors, and vendor DevRel figures with independent credibility.

Secure endorsements, testimonials, forewords, guest posts and co-created content. Convert relationships into named, attributable contributions that can be used commercially.

Pre- and post-publication campaigns


Design and execute title-specific promotion plans covering reviewer outreach, community activations, contributor-driven campaigns and targeted list building.


Sequence activity deliberately. Amazon rank responds to recent sales, and effort spread thinly across months produces a series of spikes that decay rather than a position that holds. Campaign design should concentrate reach into launch windows where it compounds, and sustain momentum deliberately thereafter.


Partner with Growth and the commissioning team on metadata, keyword alignment and audience-specific messaging, so that traffic arrives at a page built to convert it.


Track and report on campaign performance including review velocity, sentiment, community engagement and, most importantly, the relationship between activity and sales. Partnerships, bulk and licensing


Build relationships with vendor partners, training providers, certification bodies, conference organisers, universities, bootcamps and technical training companies.


Identify and secure bulk purchase opportunities, and explore licensing and longer-term collaboration models with ecosystem partners.


Coordinate with sales and marketing on pricing, positioning and execution so that partnership opportunities are converted rather than merely identified.


Community and developer relations


Build and activate developer and practitioner communities across GitHub, Reddit, Discord, Stack Overflow and specialist forums.


Plan and support webinars, AMAs, expert panels, technical workshops and conference collaborations, working alongside the events programme where the audiences overlap.


Drive direct list growth through free events, vendor partnerships, co-branded landing pages and community activations, strengthening owned reach rather than renting attention repeatedly.


Amazon presence and the credibility layer


This is where the role has the greatest untapped impact, and where we are currently weakest.


Amazon rank is driven by sales, weighted toward recent sales. Traffic and reviews do not move it directly; they move it only by producing sales. Conversion is therefore the multiplier on everything else in this role, and credibility is what converts. A buyer choosing between our book and a plausible-looking generated one is asking whether they can trust it to be correct. Your job is to

Run a structured programme of named expert endorsements, with real affiliations and specific quotes rather than generic praise, presented consistently across every title so the pattern itself becomes a recognised standard.

Engage credible reviewers, coordinate reviewer outreach, and activate reader communities for post-launch review momentum, tracking volume, quality and sentiment.

Genuine fluency in a technical community, with the credibility to be taken seriously by practitioners. You do not need to be an engineer, but you need to be able to hold a real conversation with one.

Experience in developer relations, community management, technical marketing or a comparable outward-facing role in a technical domain.

An existing network within the relevant vertical is a strong advantage.

Campaign ownership experience, with the discipline to plan, sequence and measure rather than react.

Commercial judgement, and comfort being measured on outcomes rather than activity.

Commercial performance and rank performance of the titles assigned to you, particularly the durability of rank and unit performance (7, 30, 90 day units) rather than launch spikes alone.

Owned audience reach.

Sequence activity deliberately. Amazon rank responds to recent sales, and effort spread thinly across months produces a series of spikes that decay rather than a position that holds. Campaign design should concentrate reach into launch windows where it compounds, and sustain momentum deliberately thereafter.
Partner with Growth and the commissioning team on metadata, keyword alignment and audience-specific messaging, so that traffic arrives at a page built to convert it.

Track and report on campaign performance including review velocity, sentiment, community engagement and, most importantly, the relationship between activity and sales. You are accountable for ensuring expert relationships translate into measurable commercial impact, not for the volume of outreach performed.


Partnerships, bulk and licensing
Build relationships with vendor partners, training providers, certification bodies, conference organisers, universities, bootcamps and technical training companies.

Identify and secure bulk purchase opportunities, and explore licensing and longer-term collaboration models with ecosystem partners.
Coordinate with sales and marketing on pricing, positioning and execution so that partnership opportunities are converted rather than merely identified.


Community and developer relations
Build and activate developer and practitioner communities across GitHub, Reddit, Discord, Stack Overflow and specialist forums.
Plan and support webinars, AMAs, expert panels, technical workshops and conference collaborations, working alongside the events programme where the audiences overlap.
Drive direct list growth through free events, vendor partnerships, co-branded landing pages and community activations, strengthening owned reach rather than renting attention repeatedly.


Amazon presence and the credibility layer
This is where the role has the greatest untapped impact, and where we are currently weakest.
Amazon rank is driven by sales, weighted toward recent sales. Traffic and reviews do not move it directly; they move it only by producing sales. Conversion is therefore the multiplier on everything else in this role, and credibility is what converts. A buyer choosing between our book and a plausible-looking generated one is asking whether they can trust it to be correct. Your job is to answer that on the page, before they have to guess.
In practice:
  • Run a structured programme of named expert endorsements, with real affiliations and specific quotes rather than generic praise, presented consistently across every title so the pattern itself becomes a recognised standard.
  • Engage credible reviewers, coordinate reviewer outreach, and activate reader communities for post-launch review momentum, tracking volume, quality and sentiment.
  • Build systems that sustain visibility beyond the launch cycle, and ensure credibility assets are in place before launch rather than retrofitted, since rank decays faster than a page can be repaired.
What we are looking for
  • Genuine fluency in a technical community, with the credibility to be taken seriously by practitioners. You do not need to be an engineer, but you need to be able to hold a real conversation with one.
  • Experience in developer relations, community management, technical marketing or a comparable outward-facing role in a technical domain.
  • An existing network within the relevant vertical is a strong advantage.
  • Campaign ownership experience, with the discipline to plan, sequence and measure rather than react.
  • Commercial judgement, and comfort being measured on outcomes rather than activity.
  • Strong written communication and the ability to represent Packt publicly.
  • Comfort with data, including Amazon performance metrics, campaign analytics and the relationship between reach, conversion and rank.
How success is measured
  • Commercial performance and rank performance of the titles assigned to you, particularly the durability of rank and unit performance (7, 30, 90 day units) rather than launch spikes alone.
  • Conversion strength of product pages, including the completeness and consistency of the credibility stack across the list.
  • Review volume, velocity and quality.
  • Growth and quality of the expert network, measured by contributions secured rather than contacts collected.
  • Owned audience reach.
  • Partnership and bulk revenue.
  • Quality and timeliness of community intelligence feeding into commissioning decisions.

We are a global and remote-first business with most of our team based in India and the UK. We recognize how important our people are and acknowledge and support the things that are important to them. Our culture is open and informal and based around learning. We love sharing ideas and we want everyone to feel that they have an input into how the business works. We focus on the full employee experience. We seek to achieve this by:

  • Experience delivering product demonstrations and conducting technical evaluations or proof-of-value engagements.

We build agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions for enterprise clients across construction, finance, procurement, healthcare and real estate. jobDescription:
About Zenara

Zenara is building technology to enable a new way to practise psychiatry: whole-person, continuous and psychiatrist-led care.

Our products help psychiatric practices understand patients more deeply before visits, capture more useful signal between visits, and support more consistent ongoing care - while keeping the psychiatrist firmly at the centre of clinical decision-making.

We are a growing, distributed company with team members working across India and other international markets. We are expanding the team, and we need a highly organised and trusted person to strengthen our recruitment, people-operations and executive-administration capabilities.

About the role

You will support our founders and leadership team across four connected areas: recruitment coordination, HR and people administration, timesheet and payroll administration, and confidential executive support.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role. You will keep processes moving, maintain accurate records, communicate clearly with candidates and colleagues, and make sure agreed tasks are completed reliably and on time.

To be clear about the level: this is not a senior HR strategy or employment-law role. We are looking for someone practical, highly organised, discreet, and capable of independently running routine people and administrative workflows without being chased.

You will have access to sensitive information - employee records, compensation details, candidate information, company plans and leadership discussions. Trust, discretion and sound judgement are essential parts of the job, not add-ons to it.

What you will own 1. Recruitment coordination
  • Maintain the recruitment pipeline across multiple open positions
  • Keep Workable, Linear and other recruitment trackers accurate and up to date
  • Review incoming applications against agreed role requirements
  • Organise and prioritise candidates for review
  • Coordinate first-round screening and interviews
  • Communicate with candidates throughout the process
  • Schedule interviews across India, US and other relevant time zones
  • Send interview instructions, reminders and follow-ups
  • Track candidate completion of screening, interviews and assessments
  • Coordinate background and reference checks where required
  • Prepare candidate information for interviewers
  • Maintain accurate records of interview outcomes and next steps
  • Make sure candidates are followed up promptly and professionally
  • Support offer, pre-boarding and onboarding administration
  • Help improve our recruitment workflows and systems as we scale

We are building technology-supported recruitment workflows, including automated candidate screening, interview processes, ranking and follow-up. You will help operate, monitor and improve those workflows rather than relying only on manual administration.

2. HR and people administration
  • Maintain accurate employee records and HR documentation
  • Support employee onboarding and offboarding
  • Coordinate collection of required employee information and documents
  • Track leave, attendance and other routine people-administration matters
  • Maintain records of probation periods, review dates and employment milestones
  • Prepare standard HR letters, documents and internal records
  • Support the administration of employment agreements
  • Make sure routine HR processes are completed consistently and on time
  • Respond to straightforward employee administration questions
  • Escalate sensitive or complex employee matters to the founders
  • Keep HR files organised, accurate and accessible

This role provides HR administration and coordination. You will not be expected to provide independent legal, employment-law or senior employee-relations advice.

3. Timesheets and payroll administration
  • Collect and monitor employee timesheets
  • Follow up on missing or incomplete submissions
  • Maintain accurate records for payroll processing
  • Prepare payroll inputs for review and submission
  • Coordinate with payroll providers, accountants and other relevant parties
  • Track payroll-related questions and issues
  • Maintain records of approved payments and payroll documentation

You will not own payroll, compensation or employment-policy decisions. Your responsibility is to make sure the administrative process is accurate, organised and completed on time.

4. Executive assistance
  • Provide trusted administrative support to our two co-founders
  • Manage and coordinate calendars and meetings
  • Schedule internal and external meetings
  • Prepare agendas, action lists and follow-up trackers
  • Record or organise meeting actions where required
  • Follow up with team members on agreed actions
  • Coordinate travel arrangements and related logistics
  • Organise documents and information for leadership discussions
  • Assist with practical administrative tasks and research
  • Support occasional projects that need careful coordination and follow-through

This will include practical, get-it-done administrative work. You should be comfortable handling a broad range of tasks without losing sight of priorities.

5. Confidentiality and information management
  • Treat employee, candidate, compensation and company information as strictly confidential
  • Store and share sensitive information only through approved systems
  • Use sound judgement about who should have access to what
  • Maintain professional boundaries with colleagues
  • Avoid informal discussion of confidential matters
  • Escalate any suspected confidentiality or data-security issue immediately

You will be part of the trusted leadership-support function. You should be comfortable working openly and warmly with the wider team while understanding that some information simply must not be shared.

Your first 60 days
  • Understand our current recruitment and HR workflows
  • Review and organise existing employee and candidate records
  • Get familiar with Workable, Linear and our other systems
  • Take ownership of recruitment coordination for the roles we have open
  • Establish a reliable process for interview scheduling and candidate follow-up
  • Take over timesheet and payroll administration
  • Document recurring HR and executive-administration processes
  • Establish a regular reporting rhythm with the founders
  • Identify administrative gaps, duplication or unnecessary manual work
What success looks like
  • Recruitment pipelines stay accurate and current
  • Candidates receive timely, professional communication
  • Interviews are scheduled efficiently and follow-ups are never missed
  • Recruitment workflows are consistently operated and steadily improved
  • Employee records and HR documents are complete and organised
  • Timesheet and payroll administration is accurate and on time
  • Routine HR questions and administrative requests are handled without escalation
  • The founders spend materially less time on scheduling, follow-up and administrative coordination
  • Sensitive information is handled with complete discretion
  • The company has a more reliable and scalable people-operations process
Requirements Required
  • Previous experience in HR administration, recruitment coordination, executive assistance, office administration or people operations
  • Experience coordinating several tasks, candidates or workflows at the same time
  • Strong organisational skills and genuine attention to detail
  • Excellent written and verbal English
  • Confidence communicating with candidates, employees, consultants and senior leaders
  • Experience maintaining accurate records, trackers and documentation
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office or equivalent
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, distributed environment
  • Strong follow-through, and the willingness to chase outstanding actions
  • Mature judgement when handling confidential information
  • Ability to prioritise and meet deadlines
  • Comfort learning new software, automation tools and AI-enabled workflows
  • A calm, professional and dependable working style
Strongly preferred
  • Experience recruiting for a startup or growing technology company
  • Experience supporting recruitment across multiple roles at once
  • Experience using Workable, Linear, an applicant-tracking system or equivalent
  • Experience with timesheet and payroll administration
  • Previous experience as an executive assistant to founders or senior leaders
Nice to have
  • Experience supporting international or distributed teams
  • Experience coordinating across India, US and UK time zones
  • Experience working with confidential compensation or employee information
  • Familiarity with AI tools and workflow automation
  • Experience documenting and improving administrative processes
Who you are
  • Trustworthy and discreet
  • Highly organised
  • Reliable and responsive
  • Comfortable taking ownership of routine tasks
  • Willing to ask when something is unclear
  • Able to work with limited supervision
  • Calm under pressure
  • Professional with candidates and employees
  • Comfortable in a fast-moving company
  • Practical and solutions-oriented
  • Accountable for completion, not just activity
Working hours and location

This is a fully remote role, based anywhere in India.

You will work primarily during Indian working hours, with planned and reasonable overlap with the founders when required. This role should not require a routine late-night schedule. Any out-of-hours work will be occasional, agreed in advance, and proportionate to the business need.

You will work remotely but in regular contact with the founders. Expect regular leadership check-ins, clear written updates on recruitment and HR workflows, accurate records in the relevant systems, prompt escalation of blockers, visible tracking of outstanding actions, and reliable availability during agreed hours.

Compensation

8,00,000 - 13,00,000 per year, as a total package. Where you land in that range depends on your experience and demonstrated ability, particularly in executive support and recruitment coordination.

  • Excellent written skills in the target language.

jobDescription:
Everbridge, a global leader in critical communications and enterprise safety solutions, is on the lookout for a Senior Full Stack
Developer to join our team in Bangalore . This is a remote/home-based position to be based anywhere in India .
As a Sr. Full Stack Developer, you will be building our next generation platform and be strong contributor to our cross-functional agile development team to ensure the features are delivered to customers that help save lives. You will be a part of our integrated physical security platform with the mission to keep people safe and operations running faster.
We provide solutions to help governments and businesses keep people safe by integrating with their physical security infrastructure into a single platform. The simple act of integrating these devices gives our customer incredible situational awareness within a single user interface to help them react, monitor, and protect the things they care about from the things they worry about. We are trusted to integrate and protect:
Government buildings
Rail, sea and air transport hubs
Corporate and business headquarters
National critical infrastructure
Law enforcement departments
Smart cities
What youll do:
  • Agile cross-functional development team - designing, developing, testing features as a team.
  • Working with Engineering Managers, Product Owners, Architects and QA Engineers - the successful developer will share responsibility for the delivery of the product features through the entirety of its development life-cycle, working as a team to deliver value.
  • Developing our Web and server solutions that integrate edge hardware devices into a situational aware platform for our customers. Examples of the different types of problems we ask the development team to solve: Displaying geospatially aware smart city data / Displaying geospatial tracking data / Saving video feed snapshots / Dynamic near real-time event processing / Video overlay integration / Access control management / Distributed site infrastructure management.
  • We primarily focus on .Net Core 6+ C# implementations and regularly integrate with functional library frameworks within our AWS Kubernetes hosted micro-services.
  • Our Web technologies focus on ReactJS micro-frontends using ES6+ Typescript alongside LESS styling with other NPM libraries.
  • We have continuous integration with Gitlab including unit testing, selenium-based GUI testing and static analysis.
What youll bring:
  • Degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • At least 5-6 years of experience as a professional software engineer (commercial/open source).
  • Good Experience with Microsoft .Net Core 6+.
  • Good understanding of Web (HTML5 / CSS3) and one of the leading JavaScript frameworks, ideally ReactJS.
  • Experience with micro-services interacting within clusters using Restful APIs (ie. OpenAPI).
  • Experience using Containers (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • A range of software development and delivery experience.
  • Eager to own feature work and be involved in the detail of across a feature s lifecycle.
  • Experience in large code-base products or enterprise grade software.
Nice to have:
  • Strong API Design Experience
  • Experience with Micro-Frontends
  • Hardware integration/API experience
  • NOSQL experience (MongoDB)
  • Event stream experience (Kafka)
  • Experience with concurrent distributed systems
  • Interest or experience in near real time computing/communication
  • Understanding of Devops

Gemini - AssureAI Engineer

2 positions

Keywords: AssureAI Evaluation Datasets Red-Teaming Bias Explainability (SHAP/LIME) Threshold Gates CI/CD Audit Evidence Python

About the Role

You are one of two hands-on operators of AssureAIs Trustworthiness pillar inside the Governance Control Tower. Where the AI Trust Compliance Engineer sets the strategy - which regulations map to which checks, what a passing threshold means - you build and run the evaluation suites that prove it, day in and day out, across a growing roster of Gemini-based agents. You report to the AI Trust Compliance Engineer and work closely with the AI Engineers building the agents you test.

What Youll Own

  • Build and maintain evaluation datasets and scenarios for each of AssureAIs 19 Trustworthiness checks (explainability, audit provenance, regulation coverage, safety guardrails) as new agents come online.

  • Run scheduled and on-commit bias, toxicity, red-team, and explainability (SHAP/LIME) suites; triage failures and route them to the right owner (AI Engineer, Integration Specialist, or Governance Engineer).

  • Maintain the CI/CD threshold-gate configuration so a failing Trustworthiness check blocks release rather than just flagging it.

  • Package audit evidence - run provenance, evidence exportability, regulation-coverage reports - for the AI Trust Compliance Engineers CSG review-board submissions.

  • Track dataset coverage and flag gaps as agent scope expands into new domains, data types, or regulatory contexts.

  • Split coverage with the second AssureAI Engineer across agent domains or pipeline stages so evaluation throughput scales with agent count.

What Were Looking For

  • 5-7 years in QA/test engineering for ML or GenAI systems, ideally with a dedicated eval framework (DeepEval, Ragas, Promptfoo, or comparable).

  • Hands-on experience with AssureAI or a directly comparable AI-assurance/evaluation platform.

  • Working knowledge of bias/fairness testing, explainability techniques (SHAP/LIME), and red-teaming/adversarial-prompt methodology.

  • Comfortable reading AI regulatory requirements (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001) well enough to translate them into test coverage.

  • Proficient in Python; comfortable wiring test suites into CI/CD (Cloud Build, GitHub Actions).

  • Detail-oriented and comfortable owning a queue of failing checks across multiple agents at once.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Gemini Enterprise / ADK agents specifically, or another enterprise agent platform.

  • Familiarity with RAG evaluation (faithfulness, hallucination, context precision/recall).

  • Prior audit or compliance-adjacent work (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar) that makes evidence packaging second nature.

What Success Looks Like

By month two: every live agent has an active Trustworthiness evaluation suite running on every commit, with clear pass/fail thresholds.

By month four: audit-evidence packages are produced on a standing cadence without ad hoc requests, and dataset coverage gaps are tracked and closed as new agents onboard.

jobDescription:
At SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG), were a global leader in smart energy technology, with over 4,000 employees, offices in 34 countries, and millions of installations worldwide.
Our innovative solutions include solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and AI-based energy management. Were committed to making clean, green energy the primary power source for homes, businesses, and beyond.
With the growing demand for electricity, the need for smart, clean energy sources is constantly rising. SolarEdge offers amazing opportunities to develop your skills in a multidisciplinary environment, covering everything from research and development to production and customer supply. Work with talented colleagues, tackle exciting challenges, and help create a sustainable future in an industry thats always evolving and innovating. Join us and be part of a company that values creativity, agility, and impactful work.
Our R&D division is growing globally, and we are looking for an experienced Embedded Control Firmware Engineer to join our dynamic team at the new R&D site in Bangalore, India.
As a Embedded Control Firmware Engineer , you will be a crucial member of the SolarEdge India R&D team, responsible for developing embedded control firmware for our advanced solar energy products. You will play a key role in designing, implementing, and testing embedded control firmware, ensuring its reliability, performance, and seamless integration with our hardware platforms.
Responsibilities:
  • Lead, design and development of embedded control firmware for SolarEdges solar power conversion products, including inverters, power optimizers, and energy storage converter.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including hardware engineers, embedded developers, and product/project managers, to define system requirements, design concepts/ideas and agreed with innovative architect embedded solutions.
  • Develop and implement efficient and reliable embedded digital control firmware in C/C++ for various microcontrollers and processors used in SolarEdge products.
  • Conduct thorough testing and verification of embedded control firmware to ensure its functionality, performance, and compliance with quality standards.
  • Troubleshoot and debug embedded control firmware and hardware interactions, identifying and resolving issues throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback to team members and ensuring code quality and adherence to coding standards.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends and advancements in embedded systems to propose and integrate cutting-edge technologies into SolarEdges products.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing and validation teams to support the production and testing of embedded control firmware during the manufacturing process.
  • Support the certification process by providing necessary documentation and technical inputs to comply with relevant safety and regulatory standards.

  • Bachelors (B.E./B.Tech.) in Electrical/Electronic Engineering with 4+ years of relevant industrial experience in embedded control firmware design and development ( Or )
  • Master s degree (M.E./M.Tech.) in Power Electronics/ Control System/Embedded System Engineering with 3+ years of relevant industrial experience in embedded control firmware design and development ( Or )
  • Ph.D . in Closed loop control firmware design and development for Power converter/Inverter/DC-DC Converter
  • Design and Implementation of embedded digital control algorithms in C/C++ for power converter, such as DC/AC Inverters and DC/DC converters operating at high switching frequency.
  • Strong knowledge and proven experience in developing control algorithms for Power electronics converters/Inverters.
  • Experience in optimizing firmware algorithms to enhance system efficiency and reliability .
  • Experience in Control loop Simulation and Software-in-the-loop (SIL) using PLECS/MATLAB tools.
  • Experience with Hardware-in-the Loop (HIL) using Typhoon HIL /MATLAB is desirable.
  • Experience in Real-time operating systems (RTOS) and bare-metal code development. - Strong understanding of microcontrollers / microprocessors and it s peripherals , and embedded system architectures.
  • Hands on embedded control firmware experience using MCU s such as TI/ST/Renesas etc.
  • Working knowledge on the protocols and devices driver for SPI, I2C, UART, CAN.
  • Ability to identify, troubleshoot firmware / hardware technical problems.
  • Experience developing device drivers and execute a tight interrupt loop in bare metal implementation.
  • Working knowledge in using JTAG/SWD debugger.
  • Experience in board bring-up, peripheral integration, and device driver development.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with a track record of delivering robust and reliable embedded software.
  • Knowledge of software development tools, version control systems, and debugging tools for embedded systems.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Experience in the renewable energy or power electronics industry is an added advantage. - Provide technical support and troubleshooting assistance during product development. Stay up to date with the latest advancements in power electronics and firmware technologies.
  • Drive results within constraints of Product life cycle development and production at scale.

Job Description
About the Role:
We are building and running mission-critical production infrastructure on Kubernetes. As a Senior Kubernetes Engineer, you will own the full stack from the underlying OS and container runtime through networking, storage, and the cluster control plane itself. You will engage across the full lifecycle: architecture, deployment, hardening, and day-2 operations for multi-cluster, multi-tenant environments. This is hands-on infrastructure work with direct ownership of production reliability.
What you will be doing:
Design, deploy, and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters across bare-metal, cloud, and hybrid environments.
Manage cluster lifecycle end-to-end: provisioning, version upgrades, patching, scaling, and capacity planning
Architect and run multi-cluster/multi-tenant setups using Kamaji, Rancher (hosted control planes), and vCluster (virtual clusters)
Configure and troubleshoot CNI plugins (Calico, Cilium) pod networking, network policies, BGP, and eBPF dataplanes.
Own cluster DNS (CoreDNS) configuration, service discovery, and resolution troubleshooting.
Manage container runtime (containerd, CRI-O) and underlying OS: Linux tuning, kernel/sysctl parameters, systemd, cgroups
Deploy and operate service mesh (Istio, Cilium mesh) for traffic management
Manage persistent storage: PV/PVC, StorageClasses, CSI drivers (Rook/Ceph, Longhorn, cloud-native CSI)
Own the network stack: ingress controllers, load balancing, MetalLB/BGP, firewalling, and network troubleshooting
Implement GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code (ArgoCD/FluxCD, Terraform, Helm) for cluster and workload delivery
Harden clusters: RBAC, Pod Security Standards, network policies, secrets management (Vault, Sealed Secrets), image scanning
Own backup and disaster recovery (Velero, etcd snapshotting) and run DR drills
Provide on-call production support: monitor cluster health, troubleshoot incidents, and drive root-cause resolution
Create comprehensive documentation, runbooks, and knowledge bases for operational continuity and knowledge transfer
What we need to see:
Core Kubernetes Infrastructure (5+ years)
Deep expertise in Kubernetes architecture: control plane, etcd, kube-apiserver, scheduler, controller-manager, kubelet
Proven experience designing, deploying, and troubleshooting production clusters at scale
Hands-on with multi-cluster/multi-tenant tooling Rancher, Kamaji, and/or vCluster (strongly preferred)
CNI expertise: Calico, Cilium network policy design, BGP, VXLAN/IPIP encapsulation, eBPF
Container runtime internals: containerd, CRI-O, runc configuration and troubleshooting
Strong Linux systems administration: kernel tuning, systemd, cgroups/namespaces, sysctl, package/OS lifecycle management
Storage: PV/PVC, StorageClasses, CSI drivers, Ceph/Rook, Longhorn, NFS
Service mesh experience: Istio, Linkerd, or Cilium service mesh
CoreDNS configuration, custom resolvers, and DNS troubleshooting in cluster environments
Networking depth: ingress controllers (NGINX, Envoy, Traefik), load balancing, MetalLB, and diagnostic tooling (tcpdump, iptables/nftables, conntrack)
Automation Infrastructure-as-Code:
Helm chart authoring and lifecycle management
GitOps workflows: ArgoCD or FluxCD
IaC and configuration management: Terraform, Ansible
CI/CD pipeline integration for cluster and application delivery
Scripting proficiency: Bash and Python (Go a plus)
Ways to stand out from the rest:
Kubernetes certifications: CKA, CKAD, CKS
Production experience with Rancher, Kamaji, and vCluster together (fleet/hosted-control-plane management)
Multi-cloud Kubernetes: EKS, AKS, GKE, and bare-metal
Experience with GPU-enabled clusters and AI/ML workload scheduling
Familiarity with AI/LLM serving stacks on Kubernetes vLLM, KServe, Triton Inference Server, GPU operator/device plugin, MIG partitioning
General AI infrastructure knowledge: model serving patterns, inference autoscaling, GPU scheduling constraints
Contributions to CNCF projects or an active open-source/GitHub presence
Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor s degree in computer science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent industry experience)
5+ years of hands-on production Kubernetes experience
Demonstrated ownership of CNI, DNS, storage, and networking within Kubernetes environments
Solid grounding in containerd/OS-level troubleshooting
Production on-call and incident-response experience.
Soft Skills:
Strong problem-solving and debugging abilities under production pressure
Ownership mindset with accountability for platform reliability and stability
Cross-functional collaboration with application, security, operations and platform teams
Proactive approach to continuous learning and staying current with the Kubernetes/CNCF ecosystem
Strong documentation and communication skills, with ability to defend design decisions in peer reviews

  • Experience with WebView, hybrid apps, or JS bridges

  • Experience with offline support, caching, and low-network optimization

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,000+ employees and 24,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

Cvents strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation At Cvent, we re committed to continuous learning and adaptation-AI isn t just a tool for us, it s part of our DNA. We re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you re excited to be part of a team that s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we d love to meet you.

Responsibilities

The Scrum Master at Cvent (SM) facilitates processes, escalates impediments, manages risk, and helps to drive continuous improvement at the team level. The scrum master acts as a servant leader to the team and promotes scrum best practices and coaches the team to track and constantly improves its velocity. The Scrum Master is expected to handle 2-3 Sprint teams as a Scrum Master.

  • Helps to establish sprint cadence.
  • Coordinates with product owners to keep the sprint team s backlog ready and groomed.
  • Facilitates sprint planning, review, daily scrum, refinement meetings, and retrospective events at the team level.
  • Publishes committed sprint objectives.
  • Identifies and escalates impediments.
  • Manage team or project level risks and issues and take corrective actions to mitigate them, develop mitigation strategies and support the teams in addressing challenges.
  • Maintains relevant metrics to help the team monitor their performance.
  • Coordinates elements of the sprint plan with other technology staff outside of the project.
  • Take responsibility for managing dependencies within the sprint team as well as those dependencies from other development or operations teams.
  • Participates as well as facilitate Scrum of Scrums.
  • Encourages Architect, UX, QT and Sprint team collaboration.
  • Coordinates timely response and support to production line customer issues and helps to ensure that team maintains adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLA).
  • Facilitate Project / Epic estimation process.
  • Identify and promote opportunities for integrating AI tools and automation into team processes for improved efficiency (e.g., backlog refinement, reporting, estimation, or retrospective analysis).
  • Documentation and Reporting: Maintain project documentation such as sprint plans, burndown charts, and crucial project documents like the Risk Register and Project Charter. Provide regular updates on project progress to stakeholders.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as a key point of contact for stakeholders regarding project progress and deliverables, ensuring they are informed and engaged throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Actively encourage and guide the team in applying AI-driven insights to optimize workflows, improve sprint predictability, and address bottlenecks.
  • Communicates sprint/team or project status to stakeholders at a fixed cadence.
  • Coordinate work teams consisting of RD / SRE / Cloud Operations / blended teams using agile methodologies.
  • Promotes adherence to Agile software development best practices.
  • Ensure team members have the necessary resources to complete their tasks.
  • Ensure that sprint team deliverables meet the required quality standards.
  • Drives continuous improvement initiatives at the team level.
  • Collaborate with team members and stakeholders to identify and resolve issues.
  • Acts as an Agile coach to the development team.

Requirements

  • 4-7 years of technical experience including 2-5 years of experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach.
  • Understanding backlog tracking, burn down metrics, velocity, task definition, and other Agile terminology.
  • Large/enterprise application development experience using Agile methodologies preferred but not required.
  • Strong leadership, time management, conflict resolution, and analytical skills.
  • Able to act as servant leader at the team level or project level.

Job Description

Be part of something bigger. Decode the future.

At Electrolux, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.
Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute and grow together.
Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home.

All about the role:

As a Data Engineer at Electrolux Global Data AI (GDAI) Team, you are the backbone of our digital supply chain for information - the person who turns raw, scattered data into reliable and trusted data and AI products. You will work across the full lifecycle of data, from ingestion through transformation to delivery, on our modern Lakehouse stack built on Azure Databricks. Like the Data Engineering teams at the worlds largest tech companies, we hold a high bar: we hire builders who think like owners, dive deep into ambiguous problems, and are equally comfortable architecting a pipeline as they are explaining a metric to a business stakeholder. You will have broad exposure across ingestion, platform, modeling, and delivery, and you will help define the boundary between our Platform and Product Data Engineering functions as our data organization scales.

What you ll do:

  • Data Ingestion Integration: Design and build pipelines that reliably move data from a wide variety of source systems - relational databases, external sources and operational datastores - into our Lakehouse, merging disparate sources into a single, trustworthy picture for the business.

  • Transformation Modeling: Build and maintain ELT pipelines using dbt to transform raw data into clean, well-modeled, business-ready assets, applying dimensional modeling and consistent KPI definitions so the same metric never means two different things in two different dashboards.

  • Platform Contribution: Operate and extend our Azure Databricks Lakehouse, contributing to schema design, query optimization, and scalable data processing so the platform scales reliably as data volume and complexity grow.

  • Orchestration Reliability: Own end-to-end pipeline orchestration in Airflow, building workflows that run in the right order, recover automatically from failure, and are observable through monitoring, alerting, and audit trails.

  • Data Quality Trust: Implement automated data quality checks and testing so that accuracy, completeness, and timeliness are verified continuously, not discovered by a business user staring at a broken dashboard.

  • Data Mesh Domain Ownership: Apply data mesh principles to design data products with clear ownership, discoverability, and contracts across domains, reducing tight coupling between teams and enabling other domains to self-serve trusted data.

  • Automation Engineering Rigor: Bring a software engineering mindset to Data Engineering - version-controlled code, CI/CD, code review, and Infrastructure as Code - so pipelines are tested, repeatable, and maintainable rather than one-off scripts.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work directly with business stakeholders to translate ambiguous requirements into scalable data solutions and collaborate closely with the Platform and AI teams to align on shared infrastructure, standards, and roadmap, communicating trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Cost Performance Ownership: Monitor and optimize computing and storage costs on Azure, treating cost efficiency as a first-class engineering concern rather than an afterthought.

  • AI-Assisted Engineering: Use AI pair-programming tools such as GitHub Copilot to accelerate development and build agentic CI/CD workflows in GitHub Actions that automate testing, review, and deployment with minimal manual intervention.

Who are you

  • Proven Track Record: 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer building and operating production data pipelines at scale, ideally in a fast-paced, high-growth environment like those found at leading tech companies.

  • SQL Python: Strong hands-on skills in SQL (query optimization, schema design) and Python for pipeline development and automation.

  • Cloud Lakehouse Experience: Practical experience with a cloud data platform (Azure strongly preferred) and modern Lakehouse or data warehouse architecture.

  • Pipeline Transformation Tooling: Experience building ELT/ETL pipelines, ideally with dbt, and orchestrating them with a workflow manager such as Airflow.

  • Ownership Mindset: A track record of taking ambiguous problems from first principles to a working, reliable solution, and a comfort level moving across ingestion, modeling, and delivery as the situation demands.

  • Communication: Ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and translate business requirements into scalable, well-modeled data assets.

  • AI-Assisted Engineering: Hands-on experience using GitHub Copilot or similar AI coding assistants in daily development, and building CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.

Technical Qualifications:

Our data platform is built around a modern Lakehouse architecture. You will work with:

  • Core Platform: Azure Databricks Lakehouse on Microsoft Azure.

  • Transformation Modeling: dbt (data build tool) for version-controlled, testable data modeling.

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow for workflow scheduling, dependency management, and recovery.

  • Ingestion: Azure Data Factory and batch/streaming integration patterns.

  • Languages: Python and SQL at a professional, production-grade level.

  • Architecture: Data Mesh principles applied to domain-oriented data ownership and data products.

  • Engineering Practices: GitHub and GitHub Actions for version control and CI/CD, agentic CI/CD workflows, and Infrastructure as Code.

  • AI-Assisted Development: GitHub Copilot and similar AI pair-programming tools embedded in the daily workflow.

This is a full-time position, based in Bangalore, India.

Why work for Electrolux

  • Build at scale: Lead the development of mission-critical digital commerce experiences used by thousands of customers daily.

  • Own the architecture: Influence core technical decisions and help evolve our platform for high scalability, resiliency, and flexibility.

  • Modern tech stack: Work with cutting-edge tools in cloud, commerce, and full-stack engineering.

  • Empowered leadership: Drive strategy and execution while mentoring a world-class engineering team.

  • Growth and impact: Join a high-growth company with a culture that values engineering excellence, innovation, and transparent leadership.

As part of the Electrolux Group, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you!

The world s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. The Content Authorization team manages the end-to-end process of setting up our customers with access to broker research and other specialized content.   • Focus on improving customer satisfaction by delivering timely, accurate, and quality services.
  • Suggest process and system enhancements to increase efficiency.
  • Assist with special projects as assigned.

Job Description

About The Role:

The Platform Architect is a trusted advisor for enterprise platform strategy and governance. You define platform standards and guide technical decisions to ensure ServiceNow remains healthy, scalable, and aligned to customer goals.

Your purpose is to establish governance models, anticipate risks, and enable sustainable growth. You engage across executives, enterprise architects, and platform teams to influence decisions and ensure consistency across the program.

What You Will Do:

  • Define and maintain platform vision and strategy aligned to enterprise IT and business objectives.
  • Provide architectural guidance to ensure designs align with platform standards and leading practices.
  • Shape governance frameworks covering instance strategy, integrations, and data models.
  • Facilitate platform governance forums to drive consistent decisions across partners and teams.
  • Anticipate and mitigate platform risks (scalability, performance, technical debt).
  • Influence adoption of leading practices across customer, partner, and ServiceNow teams.
  • Provide structured feedback to ServiceNow product and engineering teams.
  • Travel of up to 50% annually may be expected.

What Success Looks Like:

  • ServiceNow is embedded as a strategic enterprise platform with clear governance models in place.
  • Platform standards are consistently applied across all delivery teams.
  • Technical risks are reduced, and scalability is maintained.
  • You are recognised as a trusted advisor on platform strategy and governance, complementing the CSE s business-value leadership. Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AIs potential impact on the function or industry.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution strategy, and program leadership.
  • Proven experience engaging at Executive level to influence platform direction and business outcomes.
  • Track record of defining enterprise-scale architectures and governance models.
  • Expertise in platform strategy, integration patterns, and delivery governance.
  • ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) plus other architecture and governance framework certifications are highly desirable.

Why This Role is Different:

  • This role is about shaping the long-term health and scalability of the ServiceNow platform. As a Platform Architect, you ll influence strategy and governance at enterprise scale, guiding decisions that make the platform a trusted foundation for business transformation.

  • It s a role for architects who want to work at the strategic level, helping customers run the platform as an asset, not just a solution.

Gushwork is reinventing how businesses get discovered online. Were an agentic AI startup that helps B2B companies show up in AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity - by building a content engine on websites designed to attract AI visitors alongside human visitors.

Were a US and Bengaluru-based company thats raised over $11M from top-tier global VCs including Lightspeed (backers of Anthropic, Grafana, Mistral), SIG , B Capital Beenext . While search behavior is rapidly shifting toward AI, most B2B companies are being left behind. Were changing that.

Were at an exciting inflection point - moving fast, solving hard problems, and building technology thats becoming critical infrastructure as AI reshapes how buyers find solutions. If you want to work on challenging problems with a talented team in a high-growth environment, wed love to meet you.

More about the role below - if you feel its a fit, we are excited to meet you!

About the role

Gushworks content programmes run on our customers own websites, on their domain, alongside everything else already there. Making that work means dealing with whatever infrastructure a business has accumulated over a decade: DNS configured by an agency that is no longer involved, a CDN nobody set up deliberately, redirect rules that predate the current marketing team. Every customer is a different version of that problem.

The Implementation Engineer owns it. The role sits closer to engineering, and combines hands-on technical setup with direct customer communication.

What youll do

  • Own the technical implementation for new customers end to end: review their environment, access, configuration and technical dependencies ahead of implementation, take the setup live, and verify the result.

  • Work directly with customers to configure and validate setups, including calls with their in-house developers or agency partners as well as their marketing teams.

  • Diagnose customer-specific issues across websites, APIs, networking and web infrastructure, and determine what can be resolved independently and what requires Engineering.

  • Own the customer-facing communication end to end. Validate the fix, then explain what happened in language a non-technical stakeholder can act on.

  • Establish where a customers domain, DNS and hosting access sits, including on older setups where this is not documented, and confirm the results of automated checks before relying on them.

  • Reduce recurring issues through documentation, improvements to the implementation process, and structured feedback to Product and Engineering.

  • Partner with Customer Success, Engineering and Web Development to gather context on customer requirements and share technical findings.

What were looking for

This role requires two things together. Most candidates have one.

  • Strong technical depth. Working knowledge of HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, domains, reverse proxies, CDNs, caching, SSL and basic networking, at a level sufficient to debug them rather than describe them.

  • Strong written and verbal communication. In particular, the ability to explain a technical issue in simple language to somebody who is frustrated. This is roughly half the role.

  • Willingness to work in US hours (6pm to 3am) - our customers are primarily based in the US, so the role requires flexibility to work in US time zones.

In addition:

  • 2 to 5 years of experience. Candidates earlier in their career who have hands-on experience operating web infrastructure, including on their own projects, are welcome to make the case in their application.

  • The ability to reason about two systems at once. Most answers here depend on how a customers setup and our product interact, rather than on either in isolation.

  • Strong investigative ability. Reading logs, configurations and documentation to form and test a hypothesis about an unfamiliar problem.

  • The ability to make progress independently on an unfamiliar technical issue, rather than routing it onward as a first step.

  • Ownership and follow-through, including holding several open issues at once without losing the urgent one.

Good to have

  • Experience with reverse proxies, Cloudflare, DNS, CDNs, web servers, APIs or webhooks.

  • Experience with WordPress or other website platforms.

  • Familiarity with developer tools, browser and network debugging, logs, and basic scripting.

  • Experience with SaaS products and customer integrations.

  • Prior experience in Implementation Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Integration Engineering or a similar role.

  • Documentation or help content you have written that measurably reduced a category of customer questions.

  • Prior experience working US hours.

Why youll love us

  • Youll be part of an early team at a fast-growing company, with a lot of impact

  • Youll get to work with really smart and helpful people

  • We constantly adopt the latest technologies and stay close to the latest ai innovations

  • Opportunity to influence the direction of the product and engineering culture

  • Flexible PTO policy

  • Unlimited ai usage

  • Plus cool swag, a stocked pantry, and other benefits

jobDescription:
Role Summary

The Implementation Analyst I role is responsible for developing, configuring, testing, and supporting chatbot and workflow automation solutions using low-code platforms. The role focuses on implementing business requirements through chatbot development, workflow automation, and API integrations while ensuring solution quality and adherence to best practices.

The ideal candidate should possess a strong mix of:

  • Chatbot and workflow development
  • Low-code platform knowledge (Chatlayer, Node-RED or similar)
  • API integration and troubleshooting
  • Problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Learning mindset and technical curiosity

Key Responsibilities

Chatbot & Workflow Development

  • Design and develop automation workflows and chatbot solutions using Chatlayer, Node-RED, or similar low-code platforms.
  • Configure, develop, test, and deploy chatbot solutions based on business requirements.
  • Implement conversational flows, business logic, and workflow automation.
  • Support enhancements and maintenance of existing chatbot implementations.

Automation & Integration

  • Develop and integrate chatbot workflows with REST (JSON) and SOAP APIs.
  • Configure third-party system integrations using APIs.
  • Assist in implementing workflow automation to improve business processes.
  • Perform API testing and troubleshoot integration-related issues.

Testing & Support

  • Perform functional testing and quality assurance of chatbot and workflow solutions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve workflow, chatbot, and integration issues.
  • Ensure chatbot implementations comply with security and data protection guidelines.
  • Provide production support and bug fixes for deployed solutions.

Documentation & Process

  • Prepare workflow documentation and implementation guides.
  • Follow coding standards and implementation best practices.
  • Continuously learn new automation technologies and contribute to process improvements.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related engineering discipline.

Experience

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in chatbot development, workflow automation, low-code platforms, or application development.

Required Skills & Knowledge

  • Experience with Chatlayer, Node-RED, Power Automate, or similar automation platforms.
  • Experience developing chatbot solutions from design through deployment.
  • Good understanding of workflow design and automation concepts.
  • Basic knowledge of REST (JSON) and SOAP API integrations.
  • Understanding of third-party API integration concepts.
  • Basic knowledge of Python.
  • Basic understanding of relational databases and SQL.
  • Knowledge of JavaScript fundamentals.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.
  • Ability to learn new technologies and adapt to changing priorities.

Preferred Skills

  • Familiarity with Active Directory (AD), LDAP, SAML, Single Sign-On (SSO), Identity Management (IDM), SSL/TLS, PKI, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, and URI concepts.
  • Exposure to chatbot platforms, conversational AI, or workflow automation tools.
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and testing practices.
  • Exposure to enterprise application integrations will be an added advantage.
